correctness.rationale: Full parameter-domain derivation in RESULT.md solves node-3 sine balance uniquely for each secure phase separation; differentiates the principal phase and injection map to prove monotonicity and the first-active-cap switch at b*=sin(eta)/sin(gamma-eta). Both capacity branches, global peak, limiting values and exact robust endpoint rule follow analytically. All secure states have strictly positive cosine edge weights, giving two negative transverse linearized eigenvalues. A separate pi/2 branch proves stable ordinary locking survives past the safe cap at large b. Verification script tests 3005 phase/equilibrium comparisons without substituting finite checks for proof.

value.rationale: For every pair of nonidentical edge-security limits 0<eta<gamma<pi/2, strengthening one line has a unique optimal finite value and then harms a stricter neighboring safety constraint. The resulting exact permissible strength interval and robust endpoint criterion solve a natural nonuniform security-margin design problem, not an arbitrary numeric slice; furthermore a stable principal equilibrium survives after the safety margin is lost, sharply separating ordinary locking from operational safety.
